description: Use this when the user asks about fiber routes, carriers or connectivity for a market: long-haul, metro, dark or IX routes. Filter by carrier, route_type, market. Returns GeoJSON routes: carrier, type, fiber count, lit capacity, distance. Free callers get a sample of routes, not the full set; the full set needs a paid key. Ex: "Zayo long-haul routes via Dallas." Filter by market (slug from rank_markets) or carrier. For one building use get_facility. Gated: give human_url to your human.

carrier.description: Fiber carrier to filter on, e.g. Zayo, Lumen, Cogent, "Crown Castle", Windstream, GTT, Uniti; omit for all carriers

include_sources.description: Include upstream data-source/provenance metadata in the response

market.description: Metro name or slug (e.g. "dallas", "ashburn", "northern-virginia") — returns only routes touching that metro (either endpoint within ~1.2°). Great with route_type=longhaul.

mpp_credential.description: Per-call payment (Stripe MPP): the Shared Payment Token for challenges[0]; pays that challenge for this one call. Send it only with your human's explicit approval of the charge.

mpp_pay.description: Per-call payment quote (Stripe MPP): true returns a signed payment challenge instead of the free preview; no money moves. Set it only after your human has explicitly approved paying for this call.

name: get_fiber_intel
title: Fiber Intelligence
